text:
Elaine: Quick design ping 100 — sketched a small IA change to make console navigation more predictable across share links and mobile. Idea: group sidebar by workflow (Datasets | Models | Deployments), breadcrumbs that reflect the workflow flow, and canonicalize fragment anchors into path segments. Sketch: https://www.figma.com/file/example/rail-flow-sketch
Sam: Shared a lightweight prototype in Figma, shows accordion groups + compact mode: https://www.figma.com/file/example/rail-compact-proto
Priya: Grouping makes sense. Concern: density on narrow viewports. We should avoid forcing double-scroll (rail + main).
Matt: Proposal: auto-collapse groups at <= 1200px and use single-column focus management. Also ensure group toggles are keyboard operable (Enter/Space) and arrow key navigation inside group.
DesignBot: A11y checklist: add aria-expanded & aria-controls on group toggles, focus goes to first link when expanding, return focus on collapse, and expose a visible "Skip to main" link on keyboard focus. Screen reader should announce when a legacy anchor is rewritten.
Elaine: About anchors: canonicalize `#predictions` to `/predictions` client-side via history.replaceState so we don't add extra back entries. Keep a one-time toast: "Using an updated link format, redirected to Predictions".
Sam: We should accept legacy fragments for backwards compatibility. Client rewrite should preserve query params like `?from_dashboard=1` so attribution isn't lost. Also log old->new mapping for telemetry.
Priya: Ephemeral UIs (compose, quick-run) should remain query params, e.g. `?overlay=compose`, to keep modal semantics clear and ESC/back consistent.
Matt: Breadcrumb rules: Workspace > App > Flow. Use slugs, not raw IDs, to avoid leaking internal identifiers in shared links. On small screens, collapse middle crumbs into an overflow menu.
Elaine: Example canonical paths we want: `/orgs/:orgSlug/apps/:appSlug`, `/orgs/:orgSlug/apps/:appSlug/predictions`, `/orgs/:orgSlug/apps/:appSlug/versions/:versionSlug`. Client accepts `#predictions` and rewrites to `/predictions` silently (replaceState).
Sam: Rollout plan: canary 10% of orgs. Add Puppeteer tests for keyboard nav, focus order, skip link presence, and toast behavior. Ship a migration helper that maps legacy anchors to new routes.
Priya: Add keyboard-only QA steps and screen reader smoke tests. Also ensure truncated breadcrumbs still announce full path for SR users via a visually-hidden list.
Matt: Ops note: avoid showing the rewrite toast more than once per session. Also capture session replay snapshots when old anchors are used so we can debug regressions.
Elaine: Decision for now: implement grouped sidebar + canonical fragment->path rewrites + responsive accordion at <=1200px + a11y focus rules + preserve query params for overlays. I'll write the spec and RFC.
Sam: Adding checklist to PR template and creating a Linear ticket: https://linear.app/rw/issue/PROD-rail-2101 (placeholder).
Priya: Add keyboard-only QA steps and screen reader smoke tests. Also ensure truncated breadcrumbs still announce full path for SR users via a visually-hidden list.
DesignBot: Added accessibility checks to the spec doc: focus order, aria attributes, skip-link presence, SR announcements after rewrite.
Elaine: Thanks all. @Sam post the spec link when it's ready and I'll coordinate the canary with infra. :rocket:
